grains.RAW.STORES: one row per fulfilment node (one channel in one Singapore planning area)
grains.RAW.STORE_DAILY: one row per node per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.STAFF_TRAINING: one row per node (staff training check snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.disruption_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(fulfilment disruption at the node in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide late-order FORECAST; order-to-ready time ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.PLAYBOOK_SEARCH over synthetic fulfilment disruption SOPs (one per channel and disruption cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.OMNICHANNEL_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.OMNICHANNEL_OPS_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, node, disruption-cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (nodes, daily late orders, disruption hours by node, fulfilment-disruption risk, order events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_ORDERS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ORDER_ALERT logs new LATE orders to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
